definition: Robert Elias Schapire is an American computer scientist renowned for his contributions to machine learning theory and its applications.
details: Proved that weak learners can be boosted into strong learners and co-invented the AdaBoost algorithm. He was formerly a computer science professor at Princeton University before joining Microsoft Research. His research focuses on theoretical and applied machine learning, with particular emphasis on ensemble learning.

explainer.lead: Robert Schapire is an American computer scientist.

contributions.name: Schapire's most significant contribution to computer science is the development of boosting, a fundamental ensemble learning algorithm that has revolutionized machine learning.
His doctoral dissertation, The design and analysis of efficient learning algorithms, earned him the ACM Doctoral Dissertation Award in 1991.

timeline.what: Doctor of Philosophy, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
